readout.label: Cryo-EM resolution of the ATOM complex

summary: A cryo-EM structure of the Trypanosoma brucei ATOM complex shows a new subunit and a dimeric channel much like the one in fungi and animals. Receptor and intermembrane-space regions differ, showing independent evolutionary solutions. The structure is a static snapshot of purified protein, so the translocation steps are inferred rather than watched.
title: Structural insights into the evolution of mitochondrial protein import from the trypanosome ATOM complex.
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
